title: The review step of the sprint skill names a reviewer mode in which python3 -c runs, since a reviewer started with acceptEdits had every python3 -c refused and could not run any planted input
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md review step 1 says the headless reviewer is started with a permission setting that lets a read-only python3 -c and a scratch script run (and its brief names the commands it may not run), so the reviewer runs each fix on a planted input instead of only reading it

run: import sys;t=open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md",encoding="utf-8").read();i=t.find("## review");seg=t[i:i+3500];sys.exit(0 if "python3 -c" in seg else 1)
